US Republicans Call for Swift End to Iran Conflict

Several Republican Senate candidates have called for an end to the conflict with Iran, with some specifically stating it "needs to come to an end as quickly as possible." This comes as the midterms approach. One report also mentioned that Iran and the US have hinted at reviving negotiations to end the ongoing conflict.
